title: PersistenceEntityContribution
description: A code-declared persistent entity: JPA/Hibernate `@Entity`, MikroORM entity, SQLAlchemy `Base` subclass, Sequelize `Model.init`, Active Record class, etc. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` (JPA/Hibernate today); future `MikroOrmScanKS`, `SqlAlchemyScanKS`, `SequelizeScanKS`, `ActiveRecordScanKS`, etc.

entitySymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the entity class. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

idAttributes.description: Attribute names (or column names) participating in the primary key.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Framework-specific facts (e.g. Hibernate `@Cacheable`, JPA inheritance strategy, SQLAlchemy `__mapper_args__`).
